caption: The drawing features two bonnets on a plain, light-colored background. The bonnet on the upper left is large, primarily black, and rendered with shading to show depth and curvature. It has a prominent wide brim and is adorned with a large black ribbon tied at the base, with the ends of the ribbon extending and curling downward in a flowing manner. To the lower right of the black bonnet, there is a smaller, less detailed bonnet drawn in a pencil or light gray tone. This bonnet also has ribbon details hanging down, and appears to be more lightly sketched, lacking the bold shading of the black bonnet. The bonnets are separated by empty space, and there are no other objects or background details in the image.
title: Bonnet
